question.problem:
Find the coordinates of the vector $x$ relative to the basis $B=\{{b}_{1},{b}_{2}\},$ where

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3 \\ 4\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 5 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ -10 \\ 4\end{aligned}].
$$

If $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]$ then what is the value of ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
question.worked_solution:
We need to find ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ such that 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{b}_{1}+{x}_{2}{b}_{2} & =x \\ {x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3 \\ 4\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 5 \\ 0\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ -10 \\ 4\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The equation above gives the system with the augmented matrix

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & -5 \\ 3 & 5 & -10 \\ 4 & 0 & 4\end{aligned}].
$$

Now, we reduce $M$ using Gaussian elimination:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & -5 \\ 3 & 5 & -10 \\ 4 & 0 & 4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-3){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & -5 \\ 0 & -4 & 5 \\ 4 & 0 & 4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-4){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & -5 \\ 0 & -4 & 5 \\ 0 & -12 & 24\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-3){R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & -5 \\ 0 & -4 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 9\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2}=-5 \\ -4{x}_{2}=5 \\ 0=9,\end{aligned}
$$

where the third equation is always false. Therefore, the system has no solution and we conclude that $x\notin \text{Span}\{{b}_{1},{b}_{2}\}.$
